attchmntText: Ndr Auto Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: NDR Auto Components Limited has scheduled an Analyst and Investor meeting for December 02, 2026. The first session is with Dron Capital and Helios Capital in Mumbai at 02:00 PM. The second session involves Genuity Capital, BCS Capital Ideas, Aamara Capital, GeeCee Holdings, Seven Rivers Holding, Piper Serica, Trivantage Capital, and Nirmal Bang AIF in Mumbai at 04:00 PM. The third session is with NV Alpha Fund Management and Capri Global Advisory Services. The schedule is subject to cancellation, rescheduling, or postponement. The company confirms that discussions will rely on publicly available documents. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared or discussed during these meetings. Rajat Bhandari, Executive Director and Company Secretary, signed the notice.

attchmntText: NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about newspaper publication
voiceSummary: NACL Industries Limited has published a notice regarding a postal ballot for shareholder approval. The e-voting period runs from November 28, 2026, to December 27, 2026. Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has also dispatched a postal ballot notice seeking member consent through remote e-voting. The resolutions include material modifications to earlier approved related party transactions with Mahindra and Mahindra Limited and Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services Limited. Additional resolutions cover modifications to transactions with Mahindra Industrial Park Chennai Limited and Mahindra World City Developers Limited. The company is also seeking approval to increase its borrowing limits and limits for creating security in connection with borrowings. The e-voting window for Mahindra Lifespace opens on November 28, 2026, and closes on December 27, 2026. Results for both companies are expected to be declared shortly after the voting period concludes.

attchmntText: Dolat Algotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: Dolat Algotech Limited received an intimation from NSE Clearing Limited on November 27, 2026, regarding a penalty for violating TM or FPI level position limits in the F and O segment. The total penalty amounts to Rs. 1,18,000, comprising a basic fine of Rs. 1,00,000 and GST of Rs. 18,000. The company states that this penalty does not have any material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities, except for the monetary penalty levied.

attchmntText: Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Gyftr Limited submitted copies of the newspaper advertisement for the notice of postal ballot to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India on November 28, 2026. The advertisement was published in the Financial Express and Pratahkal newspapers on the same date. The notice was previously sent to members on November 27, 2026. The company secretary and compliance officer, Tisha Lamba, signed the submission. The advertisement is also available on the company website at https://gyftrltd.com/. The scrip code is 507912 and the symbol is GYFTR. The company was formerly known as LKP Finance Limited.

attchmntText: Jayant Agro Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Revision
voiceSummary: Jayant Agro-Organics Limited has upgraded credit ratings for itself and its subsidiary Ihsedu Agrochem Private Limited. ICRA Limited upgraded the long-term bank facility rating to ICRA A with a stable outlook for both entities. The short-term bank facility rating remains at ICRA A2+ for both Jayant Agro-Organics Limited and Ihsedu Agrochem Private Limited. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Quess Corp Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of equity shares under the Quess Stock Ownership Plan 2020
voiceSummary: Quess Corp Limited announces the allotment of 18,537 equity shares of Rs. 10 each to Restricted Stock Unit holders under the Quess Stock Ownership Plan 2020. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved this exercise on November 28, 2026. The paid-up share capital has increased from 14,93,85,918 shares aggregating to Rs. 1,49,38,59,180 to 14,94,04,455 shares aggregating to Rs. 1,49,40,44,550. The allotted shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. The company is submitting information under Regulation 10(c) of the SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations, 2021, for the listing and trading of these shares. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Bharat Coking Coal Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited received notices from the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 27th November 2026 regarding non-compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company is liable for fines of Rs. 10,12,000 from each exchange, totaling Rs. 20,24,000 before GST. Including GST at 18%, the total payable amount is Rs. 11,94,160 per exchange. The non-compliance relates to Regulations 17(1), 18(1), 19(1), 19(2), and 20(2). The company must pay the fines within 15 days and place the matter before its Board of Directors. Failure to comply may result in freezing of promoter shareholding and potential transfer to the Z group. The company is taking steps to ensure compliance.

attchmntText: Heritage Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Heritage Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Srideep Madhavan Nair Kesavan as Chief Executive Officer of the company w.e.f. December 31, 2026.
voiceSummary: Heritage Foods Limited has intimated the resignation of Mr. Srideep Madhavan Nair Kesavan as Chief Executive Officer due to personal reasons. The resignation was tendered via letter dated November 27, 2026. The Board of Directors accepted the resignation through a Circular Resolution passed on November 27, 2026. Mr. Kesavan will be relieved from his services effective from the close of business hours on December 31, 2026. He assumed leadership in August 2021. The company has enclosed the resignation letter and required disclosure details under SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board noted the cessation of his role. No successor has been appointed in this announcement. The resignation is effective at the end of the specified date.

attchmntText: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited received in-principle approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on 27th November 2026 and BSE Limited on 26th November 2026. This approval is for the proposed issue of 1,74,73,402 equity shares and 5,68,99,880 convertible equity warrants on a preferential basis. The action is taken under Regulation 28(1) of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The company has intimated the stock exchanges regarding this regulatory clearance.

attchmntText: SUB: COMPLIANCE OF REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - DISCLOSURE OF EVENTS OR INFORMATION   EXTENSION OF ADDITIONAL CHARGE OF THE POST OF DIRECTOR (FINANCE), MTNL ASSIGNED TO SHRI RAJIV KUMAR, DIRECTOR (FINANCE) BSNL - reg
voiceSummary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited disclosed that the Department of Telecommunications extended the additional charge of the post of Director Finance to Shri Rajiv Kumar, Director Finance BSNL. This extension is for a further period of three months, effective from 01.12.2026 till 28.02.2027. The arrangement is subject to the pending approval of the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet. The charge remains in place until the appointment of a regular incumbent or until further orders, whichever is earlier. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: Britannia Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of Sapana Sakar Buildcon Private Limited by JSW Renew Energy Seventeen Limited
voiceSummary: JSW Energy Limited disclosed that its step-down wholly owned subsidiary, JSW Renew Energy Seventeen Limited, signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Sapana Sakar Buildcon Private Limited. The transaction involves cash consideration of Rs. 22 crores, subject to adjustments. The target company develops renewable energy projects and owns a site enabling accelerated development of approximately 100 MW. The acquisition is subject to conditions precedent and is expected to be completed on or before 26th December 2026. Sapana Sakar Buildcon Private Limited was incorporated on 3rd April 2005. Its revenue from operations was Nil for FY 2024, FY 2025, and FY 2026. The deal is not a related party transaction.

attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints submitted an investor presentation for an analyst meet on December 01, 2026. The Board of Shalimar Paints has approved the proposed merger of Hella Infra Market Limited into Shalimar Paints. The transaction involves a 3.14 swap ratio. Illustrative equity values are ₹1,472 crore for Shalimar and ₹30,188 crore for Infra.Market. The combined entity value is ₹31,180 crore. The merger remains subject to shareholder, stock-exchange, SEBI, NCLT, and other regulatory approvals. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared at the meet. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015 - Imposition of fine by BSE and NSE
voiceSummary: Coal India Limited received notices from the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange dated 27.11.2026 regarding non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations for the quarter ended 30th Sep 2026. The exchanges imposed a fine of Rs. 10,57,280 each, inclusive of GST. The violations involved non-compliance with Regulations 17(1), 18(1), 19(1), 19(2), 20(2)/(2A), and 21(2). The company stated that the non-compliance was not due to negligence or management control. The issue relates to the appointment of Board Members, which is under the purview of the President of India. Coal India Limited is following up with the Ministry of Coal for the appointment of Independent Directors. The company has requested a waiver of the penalty from the exchanges.

attchmntText: COMPLIANCE OF REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - DISCLOSURE OF EVENTS OR INFORMATION   DISCLOSURE OF IMPOSITION OF FINES OR PENALTY - reg
voiceSummary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited received a letter from BSE dated 27th November 2026 regarding non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations. BSE imposed fines totaling Rs. 14,23,080, inclusive of basic fines of Rs. 12,06,000 and GST of Rs. 2,17,080. The violations relate to Regulations 17, 18, 19, 20, and 21. MTNL states there is no material impact on its financial or operational activities. The company is requesting a waiver of the fines, citing that board appointments are made by the Department of Telecommunications.

attchmntText: Ashapura Minechem Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Postal Ballot Notice
voiceSummary: Ashapura Minechem Limited has published a notice regarding a Postal Ballot in the Free Press Journal and Navshakti on November 28, 2026. The notice is also available on the company website. The document includes unrelated bank auction notices. State Bank of India is auctioning two flats in Amrut Residency, Boisar, on December 29, 2026, for Prakash Kumar Jain. The reserve prices are Rs. 18,00,000 and Rs. 21,00,000. Federal Bank Limited is auctioning an office in Navratan, Mumbai, on December 18, 2026, for the heirs of Vinod Kumar Gupta. The reserve price is Rs. 1,66,35,000. Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited is auctioning a flat in Omkar Heights, Titwala, on December 18, 2026, for Sunitadevi and Manoj Kumar Mandal. The reserve price is Rs. 22,56,000.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication related to notice of Postal Ballot, e-voting and other information
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of the postal ballot and remote e-voting notice on November 28, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Nava Telangana. The company states this is pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement does not disclose the specific resolutions or voting results. The matter is pending shareholder approval.

attchmntText: KEC International wins New Orders of Rs. 1,407 crores
voiceSummary: KEC International Limited secured new orders worth Rs. 1,407 Crores. The orders were received in the normal course of business. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange under symbol KEC and on BSE under scrip code 532714. The orders span multiple business segments. Transmission and Distribution includes 220/110/30 kV Substations in Africa. It also includes an additional order for a 765 kV Transmission line from a private developer in India. Supply of towers, hardware, and poles is in the Americas. Transportation includes a composite order for doubling of railway tracks and associated civil works in India. Cables and Conductors includes various orders in India and overseas markets. Year to date order intake stands at approximately Rs. 15,000 Crores. The press release was issued on November 28, 2026.

attchmntText: Mufin Green Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Mufin Green Finance Limited has received credit ratings from Acuite Ratings & Research Limited. The letter is dated November 27, 2026. A bank loan of 300 crore rupees received an Acuite A rating with a stable outlook. This rating was assigned. A bank loan of 750 crore rupees received an Acuite A rating with a stable outlook. This rating was upgraded. Non-convertible debentures totaling 500 crore rupees received an Acuite A rating with a stable outlook. This rating was assigned. Multiple non-convertible debenture tranches totaling 710.66 crore rupees received an Acuite A rating with a stable outlook. These ratings were upgraded. Proposed bonds of 85 crore and 15 crore rupees had their ratings withdrawn. The rating letter expires on April 25, 2027.
